decks.notes: The main focus of this Control - UrzaTron deck is to assemble the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) as quickly as possible to generate a large amount of mana. This mana is then used to cast powerful spells and creatures such as Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, with support from cards like Sylvan Scrying and Expedition Map. The deck also includes various ways to control the board with cards like Oblivion Stone and Wurmcoil Engine, and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Relic of Progenitus.

The deck focuses on gaining control of the game by assembling UrzaTron lands to generate massive amounts of mana. It utilizes powerful control elements like Force of Negation, Subtlety, and Remand to disrupt the opponent's strategies and protect its own game plan. Lórien Revealed and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional value and flexibility. The deck also includes powerful win conditions like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to close out the game once it has established control. The key strategy is to dominate the game through mana advantage and powerful control elements.

The deck focuses on utilizing cascade spells to cheat big creatures into play and disrupt opponents' strategies. By cycling through cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, the player can set up a Living End combo to board wipe and bring back powerful creatures like Shardless Agent and Waker of Waves. Utilizing cards like Grief and Subtlety to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and control the game through powerful interactions.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of disruptive elements to control the game. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy with Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Molten Collapse allows for additional damage output and the potential to close out games quickly. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, disruption, and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's moves through counterspells, removal, and repeatable board manipulation. It utilizes a variety of powerful creatures, such as Omnath and Emrakul, as threats while maintaining control over the game with cards like Leyline Binding and Solitude. The deck also includes versatile lands like the Triomes and fetch lands to ensure mana consistency. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up for powerful swings with creatures and spells that can quickly close out the game.

The deck focuses on using Cascade mechanics to quickly and aggressively play powerful spells and creatures, overwhelming the opponent with card advantage and board presence. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cascade into high-impact cards such as Crashing Footfalls and Scion of Draco. The inclusion of Leylines and Force of Negation helps to protect the deck's key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck has a diverse mana base to ensure consistent and efficient casting of its spells.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures with abilities to disrupt the opponent's game plan and set up for a powerful combo finish. By cycling cards like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Grief, the player can manipulate their graveyard and hand to set up for a massive Living End spell. Cards like Shardless Agent and Subtlety provide additional value and disruption. The deck also includes Generous Ent and Oliphaunt for additional threats and Boseiju, Who Endures for protection. Force of Negation helps to protect the combo while Misty Rainforest provides mana fixing.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Tower, Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck uses powerful control spells like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also utilizing big threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine to finish the game. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection, making it a versatile and challenging deck to pilot in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures with a mix of colors for efficient mana usage. The key strategy is to quickly deploy threats like Wild Nacatl, Territorial Kavu, Nishoba Brawler, and Scion of Draco to overwhelm the opponent. Leyline of the Guildpact provides protection and Leyline Binding can help control the board. Tribal Flames can finish off opponents by dealing damage based on the number of different land types you control. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck. Throughout the game, the player aims to maintain pressure and tempo to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and playing a variety of creatures with different colors to take advantage of Leyline of the Guildpact and Tribal Flames. Scion of Draco is a powerful finisher and Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana options. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and versatile spells to secure a fast victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Explore, Search for Tomorrow, and Sakura-Tribe Elder to eventually cast Scapeshift to sacrifice lands and search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and mountains to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. Wrenn and Six helps with land recursion and card advantage, while Wish provides extra flexibility in finding the needed cards for the win condition. The goal is to control the game through removal spells like Storm's Wrath and overwhelming the opponent with Valakut triggers.

The deck focuses on using cards that allow players to cycle through their deck quickly and efficiently, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Grief. The goal is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to combo off and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on using control elements like counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes to maintain control over the game. The One Ring is a key card that helps generate advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler for additional control and card advantage. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure smooth mana acceleration and consistency. The overall strategy is to control the game until the player can establish a dominant board presence and secure a victory.

Using a combination of spells and reanimation cards, this deck aims to quickly bring powerful creatures like Yargle and Emrakul onto the battlefield for a surprise attack. It also utilizes Profane Tutor to search for key cards and The Underworld Cookbook for additional graveyard recursion. The deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to control the board while setting up its combo. With a mix of versatile cards and a focus on instant reanimation, this deck can overwhelm opponents with its explosive plays.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with specific abilities to create powerful combos and synergies. It utilizes cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling to search for key pieces, like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, while also including disruptive elements like Fulminator Mage. By carefully selecting and tutoring creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a toolbox of versatile threats and support cards, all while generating value and advantage through sacrificing and recursion effects.

This deck focuses on quickly filling your graveyard with targets for instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending, allowing you to cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play early in the game. The combination of disruptive cards like Grief and Solitude, along with versatile removal spells like Prismatic Ending, helps to control the board while setting up your combo pieces. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, using a mix of card draw, creature removal, and graveyard manipulation to overwhelm your opponents and close out the game quickly.
